links.comparator_used: Same Qwen3.5-9B model under zero-shot prompting without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Hallucination rate (accuracy below 0.70) and physician-rated accuracy, completeness, safety, readability and reliability
links.effect: Hallucination rate fell from 77.5% to 11.3% (difference −66.3 percentage points; 95% CI −76.3 to −55.0); every criterion rose by 0.24 to 0.38 points (Holm-adjusted p < 0.001)
links.tradeoff: Residual errors remained specific, confident and potentially harmful. The RAG system stayed below Gemma-4-26B-A4B (zero-shot) in safety, readability and reliability. No configuration was free of hallucination.
links.quote: Guideline grounding lowered the rate of Qwen3.5-9B to 11.3% (difference −66.3 percentage points; 95% CI −76.3 to −55.0) and raised every criterion by 0.24 to 0.38 points (Holm-adjusted p < 0.001).
